'''Tyler Deon Honeycutt''' was a player for the [[UCLA Bruins men's basketball]] team starting in 2009.<ref>http://www.uclabruins.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/honeycutt_tyler00.html</ref>  He played for two seasons, then declared for the [[2011 NBA Draft]].<ref>http://www.nbadraft.net//players/tyler-honeycutt</ref>

Coming out of [[Sylmar High School]], Tyler was very highly regarded, being rated as a top 10 [[small forward]] in the country by all of the major recruiting circuits.  His freshman year at UCLA, he played in the final 26 games, starting 18, and led the team in rebounding at 6.5 per game.  His sophomore year, he improved significantly, being named a team co-MVP, first team Pac-10 player, and leading the conference in blocks, at 2.1 per game.<ref>http://ucla.ocregister.com/2011/04/12/ucla-basketball-lee-honeycutt-nelson-team-mvps/31613/</ref>
